why: BTTS NO deep check 2026-10-29 (v9 walk-forward p_btts x real two-sided BTTS prices, 6,361 Standard matches 2024-08..2026-09):
the BTTS market prices YES too LOW in Serie B (implied 49.6% vs realised 54.6%) and La Liga 2 (49.1% vs 54.0%),
so blind YES returned +5.2% (Serie B) and +4.5% (La Liga 2) while blind NO lost -13.9% and -14.7%.
The model adds nothing on top: it flags 82% of Serie B matches as YES (+6.9%) vs +5.2% blind, and its
disagreement with the price does not rank results (all quintiles realise +1.3..+2.2pp over the price).
Same shape as Argentina BTTS (src/studies/argentina_btts.py): a league regime, not model skill.
Serie B BTTS YES with the model is already registered as H-GATE-13 (registry/candidate_forward_tests.json);
this file adds the CONTROL that tells league from model.
selection_caveat: chosen after looking at 7 leagues x 2 sides (14 cells) on the same data - the historical ROI is a discovery number, not evidence

hypotheses.strategy: back BTTS YES on EVERY Serie B match with a two-sided v9 Standard side-market price; no model
hypotheses.entry_price: FIRST pre-kickoff btts_yes quote in v9 output/standard_sidemarket_odds_history.csv (two-sided, overround 1.00-1.15, both sides <= 3.2)
hypotheses.statistical_test: flat 1u ROI at entry price, 95% matchday-block bootstrap; one-sided t
hypotheses.pass_criterion: n>=150 AND matchdays>=10 AND ROI 95% CI lower > 0 AND mean CLV >= 0 -> FORWARD_SUPPORTED
hypotheses.fail_criterion: n>=150 AND ROI 95% CI upper < 0 -> REJECTED; or n>=300 AND ROI <= 0 -> REJECTED

hypotheses.strategy: does model selection add to the league? H-GATE-13 picks (v9 raw edge >= 0.02, first sight, from output/valuable_shadow/valuable_shadow.csv) vs H-BTTS-REGIME-SB matches NOT picked, same forward window, same entry-price rule
hypotheses.statistical_test: difference in flat ROI (picked - not picked), 95% matchday-block bootstrap
hypotheses.pass_criterion: both arms n>=60 AND difference CI lower > 0 -> MODEL_ADDS
hypotheses.fail_criterion: both arms n>=60 AND difference CI upper < 0.05 -> MODEL_ADDS_NOTHING (league regime only)
hypotheses.note: if the model keeps flagging ~80% of matches, the not-picked arm fills slowly; report progress honestly, never relax the threshold
